dct_title_s: United Republic of Tanzania - Earthquake on Jan 20 2026
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000rqva](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000rqva) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jan 20 2026 10km NE of Somanga. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -8.3278 longitude 39.3491. It impacted 85522 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
